task_instance: Implement and run the skill's Load Protocol against a sample ~/.claude/company-context.md: detect staleness (>90 days), parse the required context fields into working memory, apply the Privacy Rules to produce a safe-to-send-externally payload (blocking revenue/burn/customer names/investor names/runway), and perform the Context Enrichment append-and-timestamp-bump flow.
evidence: Created a realistic sample company-context.md at home/.claude/company-context.md with 'Last updated: 2026-05-30' (120 days before the session date 2026-09-27) and all Required Context Fields plus sensitive data (ARR, burn, customer names, investor names, runway months, watch list) per SKILL.md. Wrote context_engine.py implementing: (1) file load + staleness check per the Load Protocol thresholds (<90d vs >=90d), (2) parsing into the working-memory fields the skill lists (stage, founder archetype, priority #1, 12-month target, unfair advantage, kill-shot risk, etc.), (3) the Context Quality Signals table logic (age>90 -> Low confidence, stale prompt text), (4) the Privacy Rules: 'Never send externally' fields (ARR, burn, customer names, investor names, runway) are excluded and replaced with an anonymized payload using only stage label, team-size range bucket, challenge category, and a stage-relative ARR band, matching the skill's 'Safe to use externally' list, (5) a leak-check that scans the anonymized payload for any of the raw blocked values (none found -> PASS), and (6) the Context Enrichment protocol (append a dated '## Context Update' section with a newly-learned fact and bump 'Last updated', never overwriting existing content). Ran `python3 context_engine.py home/.claude/company-context.md`, captured output to run_output.json, and verified: age_days=120 -> stale=true, confidence=Low, load_prompt matches the skill's exact staleness prompt text; anonymized_external_payload contains no raw revenue/customer/investor/runway values (anonymization_leak_check = PASS); after enrichment the file's Last updated became 2026-09-27 (age_days=0) and both the original content and the new dated update section are present in the file (confirmed by re-reading the file and re-running the staleness calculation, which returned age_days=0). No reference/anonymization-protocol.md file existed in the skill source, so anonymization logic was implemented directly from the Privacy Rules section inline in SKILL.md (Never-send-externally / Safe-to-use-externally lists), which fully specifies the required behavior for this test. No credentials, network calls, or MCP/connector tools were needed or used; everything ran locally against local files in the work directory.
